name: Tenaga Nasional Berhad
description: Malaysia's principal electricity utility: it generates power and transmits and distributes electricity across Peninsular Malaysia, and also serves Sabah and the Federal Territory of Labuan. It owns and operates the Peninsular grid and issues connection offers and network access.
notes: Registered as TENAGA NASIONAL BERHAD 199001009294 (200866-W). Headquarters city is not stated on the corporate-profile page read, so only the country is recorded.
